$comment: Public Forge UI workflow commands. Users invoke Forge, never an upstream product: each route below is a Forge command that loads the compiled upstream playbook selected by the composition engine. `aliases` preserves the pre-existing Forge UI commands so nothing that worked before stops working.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Establish product and design direction for a surface, writing PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md.

commands.name: craft
commands.summary: Build a new interface or replace a visual world at the craft floor.

commands.name: document
commands.summary: Document the existing design system, tokens, and component inventory.

commands.name: extract
commands.summary: Extract design tokens and visual truth from the existing implementation.

commands.name: shape
commands.summary: Shape information architecture, flow, and hierarchy before visual work.

commands.name: critique
commands.summary: Critique an interface against craft, hierarchy, and usability criteria.

commands.name: audit
commands.summary: Run the deterministic design detector and report evidence-backed findings.

commands.name: polish
commands.summary: Apply bounded, reversible refinement to an existing interface.

commands.name: bolder
commands.summary: Increase visual confidence and contrast where a design reads timid.

commands.name: quieter
commands.summary: Reduce visual noise where a design reads loud.

commands.name: distill
commands.summary: Remove redundancy and reduce an interface to its essential elements.

commands.name: harden
commands.summary: Cover loading, empty, error, permission, and edge-case states.

commands.name: onboard
commands.summary: Design first-run, empty-state, and onboarding experience.

commands.name: animate
commands.summary: Add motion and micro-interactions, subject to reduced-motion requirements.

commands.name: colorize
commands.summary: Establish or revise the colour system, subject to contrast requirements.

commands.name: typeset
commands.summary: Establish or revise typography, scale, and rhythm.

commands.name: layout
commands.summary: Revise spatial composition, grid, alignment, and density.

commands.name: delight
commands.summary: Add considered moments of delight without harming usability.

commands.name: overdrive
commands.summary: Push an ambitious visual effect to a technically extraordinary result.

commands.name: clarify
commands.summary: Improve interface copy, labels, and comprehension.

commands.name: adapt
commands.summary: Adapt an interface across breakpoints, platforms, and locales.

commands.name: optimize
commands.summary: Improve measured frontend performance of an interface.

commands.name: live
commands.summary: Guidance for iterating on an interface in a live browser session.
commands.limitation: Forge ships the workflow guidance for this command. The upstream interactive live server, its browser bundle, and its hook system are deliberately not vendored, so there is no bundled live-editing runtime. Use the guidance with your own browser tooling.
